title: Sluice
pitch: The whole waterworks is one connected tub — and you own the global waterline, pumping it up and down in real time.
howto: Hold FLOOD / DRAIN to move the waterline: float up to high ledges, strand pike gasping on dry rock, drown rust-crabs, quench furnaces into steam bursts and dry out keg fuses to blast walls. Find 3 valve keys, turn the Master Valve, and spend scrap on pump, lung and hull upgrades.
controls: Arrow buttons move, big button jumps (jump again in water to stroke). Wave-arrow buttons flood/drain the works. Down button dives. Keyboard: A/D move, Space jump, J flood, K drain. Gamepad supported.
